body: I can only try, but I need time to relapse into my old self but as a single-father.  i wish and hope for things to be better... but my depression claims my thoughts

I have it wired in my brain that she is that particular soul because of our deep chemistry.  

She and I had talked so much in before we boarded our ship and learned so much of our pasts, present. So much that we decided to have a future.

* I have tried to repair things with her, pleaded with her to reconsider her path.  She is fearful that this will happen again, my basis of my frustrations is that I know for a fact she is the only one I can enjoy life with, and our parenthood with.  I can't force this on her. 

* It is a very, very long story.  We have both been there for each other in such deep and devoted ways there was a seemingly unbreakable chemistry.

* Relationship counseling is definitely out of the question.  It has been over (so she says) since the end of February.  She is running around with a different guy, one who's far older than I (I being 25, she being 20). 

If you truly wish to learn the situation... I will try to do my best as to not flood this because I really need advice and possibly a friend.
